name: Filen
author: Zeus-Deus
description: Browse, download, upload and open your end-to-end encrypted Filen drive from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Filen drive browser with quota, downloads, uploads and quick open.

schema.label: Quota refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often drive usage is refreshed in the background. The panel always refreshes when opened.

schema.label: Download directory
schema.description: Where downloads are saved. Leave empty to use ~/Downloads.

schema.label: Confirm before deleting
schema.description: Ask before moving an item to the Filen trash. Strongly recommended.

schema.label: Bandwidth limit
schema.description: Cap transfer speed, e.g. 2M or 500K. Leave empty for unlimited.
